chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah narrated to us. He said: 'Abbad ibn Sulayman narrated to us from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from his father Sulayman al-Daylami from 'Umayr ibn al-Harith from 'Imran ibn Maytham from Abu Sukhayla. He said:

I went to Abu Dharr, may Allah have mercy on him, and said: O Abu Dharr! I have seen discord, so what do you order me to do? He said: You must adhere to these two things: the Book of Allah and the Shaykh 'Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.

For indeed I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, saying: This is the first who believed in me, and the first who will shake hands with me on the Day of Resurrection. He is the Greatest Truthful One (al-Siddiq al-Akbar), and he is the Distinguisher (al-Faruq) who distinguishes between truth and falsehood.

key_terms.اخْتِلَاف: Discord or schism - referring to the political divisions after the Prophet's passing
key_terms.الصِّدِّيقُ الْأَكْبَرُ: The Greatest Truthful One (al-Siddiq al-Akbar) - a distinguished title for Imam 'Ali affirming his supreme truthfulness
key_terms.الْخَصْلَتَيْنِ: The two qualities or things - the Quran and Imam 'Ali as twin sources of guidance
key_terms.الْفَارُوقُ: The Distinguisher (al-Faruq) - one who separates truth from falsehood, applied here to Imam 'Ali

ai.seo_question: What did Abu Dharr advise when asked about discord, and what titles did the Prophet give to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Abu Sukhayla narrates that he visited Abu Dharr al-Ghifari during a period of communal discord and sought guidance. Abu Dharr directed him to cling to two things: the Book of Allah and 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), citing the Prophet's testimony that 'Ali was the first to believe, the first who will greet him on the Day of Resurrection, and that he bears the titles al-Siddiq al-Akbar (the Greatest Truthful One) and al-Faruq (the Distinguisher between truth and falsehood). This advice was given in the context of early Muslim political turmoil, where Abu Dharr was known for his unwavering loyalty to the Prophet's household.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: `Abbad b. Sulayman narrated to us from Muhammad b. Sulayman from his father Sulayman al-Daylami from `Umayr b. al-Harith from `Imran b. Maytham from Abi Sukhayla. He said:
I met Aba Dharr (rh) and said: O Aba Dharr! I have seen schism, so what do you order me to do? He said: Betake to these two things: The Book of Allah and Shaykh `Ali b. Abi Talib (as), for

I have heard the Messenger of Allah (s) say: He is the first to believe in me, and he will be the first to shake hands with me on the Day of Resurrection. He is the Great Saint (al-siddiq al-akbar), and he is the Distinguisher (al-faruq) who will distinguish between truth and falsehood.
